tools.description: Check a selected returned benchmark receipt and report three acceptance layers; never collapse a reference match into general scientific validity.

tools.name: inspect_native_word
tools.description: Read Word native UTF-16 ranges, comments, fields and page positions for one explicit document; no edits or citation refresh.

tools.name: prepare_native_word_revision
tools.description: Preview range-based tracked edits and native comments against an explicit source hash; field-intersecting changes are forbidden.

tools.name: apply_native_word_revision
tools.description: Execute one reviewed native Word plan on a fresh copy; preserve source and create real comments/tracked edits. PDF rendering is a separate read-only task.

tools.name: render_native_word_pdf
tools.description: Render one explicit unchanged DOCX through installed Word to a fresh private PDF; report completion only after actual native export.

tools.name: request_native_citation_refresh
tools.description: Invoke only the installed trusted ZoteroRefresh macro on a fresh document copy; keep an unknown/pending state until explicit native review, never retry.

tools.name: create_research_project
tools.description: Create an empty private project with explicit design, scientific context and analysis plan.

tools.name: inspect_research_project
tools.description: Read one explicitly selected private project, including real state and pending gates.

tools.name: prepare_project_revision
tools.description: Preview a replacement of selected project fields; protect recorded execution states and history.

tools.name: apply_project_revision
tools.description: Commit an unchanged reviewed private project revision with a transaction and conflict check.

tools.name: advance_workflow_stage
tools.description: Advance one stage using an immutable saved receipt; fail closed on unknown submissions and unmet QC gates.

tools.name: execute_workflow_stage
tools.description: Run one reviewed allowlisted local QC/check stage, persist its real bridge receipt and stop before manual acceptance; server stages require separate explicit dispatch.

tools.name: audit_project_lineage
tools.description: Locate overlapping cohort/subject tokens and downstream claims affected by changed sources; never infer independence from different accession IDs.

tools.name: build_project_dashboard
tools.description: Render a private static task board with blocked stages, receipt snapshots and unverified software states.

tools.name: freeze_reproduction_package
tools.description: Freeze explicitly selected bounded result files, parameters, environment and commands in a private reproducibility bundle.

tools.name: create_private_backup
tools.description: Create an explicit scoped private archive using transaction-consistent SQLite backup; never discover or scan whole libraries.

tools.name: prepare_private_restore
tools.description: Preview restoring a checked backup to a fresh private staging folder; never overwrite active indexes/configuration.

tools.name: apply_private_restore
tools.description: Restore an unchanged reviewed archive into a fresh folder; check SQLite integrity and roll back only newly owned files on error.

tools.name: validate_adapter_contract
tools.description: Validate a versioned adapter SDK contract without importing or executing third-party code.

tools.name: inspect_ssh_route
tools.description: Read effective local SSH configuration without connecting or collecting credentials.

tools.name: prepare_remote_task
tools.description: Prepare a portable server task bundle, with exact argv, hostname gate and output checksums; no submission.

tools.name: prepare_server_inventory
tools.description: Prepare a read-only server software inventory task; does not connect, submit or install.

tools.name: inspect_remote_task
tools.description: Read a returned remote lifecycle receipt and check task identity; does not poll a server.

tools.name: verify_remote_results
tools.description: Check a downloaded remote receipt and expected output bytes/SHA256 against the exact task.

tools.name: audit_sample_metadata
tools.description: Check sample IDs and independent-unit counts; detect repeated units and incomplete pairing.

tools.name: audit_result_table
tools.description: Validate small server result tables for differential/MR/coloc/meta/image analysis; no local fitting.

tools.name: build_server_download_manifest
tools.description: Convert saved ENA runs into a server download manifest; no local FASTQ download.

tools.name: inspect_zotero_connection
tools.description: Check a local Zotero API without scanning a library or requesting write authorization.

tools.name: read_zotero_library
tools.description: Read one explicit collection or item set, including optional bounded notes/annotations; never scan an unspecified whole library.

tools.name: read_zotero_attachment
tools.description: Resolve a local Zotero attachment to an explicitly permitted folder; refuse network/remote file URLs and symlink escape.

tools.name: prepare_zotero_write
tools.description: Preview additive tags, plain-text notes or new references with private before snapshots; no authorization dialog or write.

tools.name: apply_zotero_write
tools.description: Explicitly dispatch an unchanged preview through Zotero's own authorization dialog; block conflicts and never retry an unknown write.
